title: From Pixels to Faces: review artefacts and re-executable face inpainting/unmasking benchmark
description: Code, Scopus query and counts, supplementary search and full screening log, coded taxonomy, test-file lists with hashes, masks, per-method configurations with output provenance, and per-image scores for the review 'From Pixels to Faces: A Comprehensive Survey of Deep Learning-Based Face Inpainting and Face Unmasking' (Artificial Intelligence Review, revised version). The generated outputs of the benchmarked methods are archived in a separate Zenodo record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24193552. CelebA and CelebA-HQ images are not included.
